## What's coming in #115

This page will document how to reach the lake from SAS — worked out and
verified in [cancer-on-ice#115](https://github.com/seandavi/cancer-on-ice/issues/115),
not invented here. Nothing SAS-specific is published on this site yet.

If you can reach a DuckDB CLI or Python environment in the meantime, the
[DuckDB CLI](duckdb-cli.qmd) page can write any query's result to a CSV
(`COPY (...) TO 'out.csv'`) for `PROC IMPORT` in the meantime.
